content: ClinicalTrials.gov still identifies NCT02555358 as Three Drugs in Advanced Gastric Cancer Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy for Stage III Clinical Study. The current API record says the study is completed, began in 2014, completed in 2022, and was last updated on 19 October 2023. Its stated purpose is to compare chemotherapy approaches; it does not describe assigning care with the RCSA prediction model.
